# Lovable

> > Lovable is an AI-powered app builder that enables developers and non-technical founders to build full-stack web applications 20x faster with integrations for Supabase, Stripe, GitHub, and Replicate.

Lovable provides a no-code/low-code platform for rapid MVP development, internal tools, and production applications. The platform features ChatGPT integration, design system support, and partnerships with VCs and startups through their AI Native Startup Playbook.

## Key Topics

- AI app builder
- No-code development
- MVP development
- Supabase integration
- Stripe payments
- GitHub deployment
- Replicate AI models
- Full-stack applications
- Internal tools automation
- AI code generation
- ChatGPT integration
- Startup partnerships
- Design systems
- API integrations
- Code security
